mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level relative to its historical median predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced borrowing costs boost corporate profitability and equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns in lowest FEDFUNDS quartile are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession fears accelerate equity selling pressure.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.7%, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) from prior month signal a synchronized demand-supply contraction that produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession expectations dominate market sentiment.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: When HOUST and INDPRO both decline, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High annual inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as markets anticipate aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes that compress equity valuations through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) levels predict positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as strong residential construction signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion that lifts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year window or average returns in highest HOUST quartile are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 persons signals labor market weakness that drives negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days as reduced consumer spending prospects depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth < 50, 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real sales (RSAFS) and declines in inflation (CPIAUCSL) from prior month signal non-inflationary economic growth that produces positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as strong demand without price pressures supports equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases from prior month
failure_condition: When RSAFS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth < 0.5% year-over-year) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as industrial sector contraction reduces corporate revenue visibility and increases recession risk premiums.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth < 0.5% yoy, 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
